title: The SCons build system cannot detect a properly configured compiler.
body:
### Tested versions

latest source code cloned todoy(2025.12.9)

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

# The SCons build system cannot detect a properly configured compiler.
Dear godot engine team:\
I cloned the godot SRC on my PC that the OS is Windows10.\
I have a MSVC compiler that installed by Microsoft Visual Studio Installer,\
and a mingw that installed with scoop.\
but when I build godot enigne ,error happend:
```bash
D:\godot>cl
用于 x64 的 Microsoft (R) C/C++ 优化编译器 19.50.35717 版
版权所有(C) Microsoft Corporation。保留所有权利。

用法: cl [ 选项... ] 文件名... [ /link 链接选项... ]usage: cl [configurations]

D:\godot>gcc --version
gcc (GCC) 13.1.0
Copyright (C) 2023 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
This is free software; see the source for copying conditions.  There is NO
warranty; not even for MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.


D:\godot>g++ --version
g++ (GCC) 13.1.0
Copyright (C) 2023 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
This is free software; see the source for copying conditions.  There is NO
warranty; not even for MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.


D:\godot>scons platform=windows
scons: Reading SConscript files ...
Auto-detected 20 CPU cores available for build parallelism. Using 19 cores by default. You can override it with the `-j` or `num_jobs` arguments.
ERROR: No valid compilers found, use MINGW_PREFIX environment variable to set MinGW path.
```
then I created the MINGW_PREFIX var in order to solve the problem, but scons still crash for no reason.\
huge thanks if you can help me solve problem ERROR: No valid compilers found, use MINGW_PREFIX environmentvariable/
to set MinGW path.\

Your's sincerely,\
codingshen

### Steps to reproduce

run commnad in cmd:
```
cl
```
to check the msvc version and
```
gcc
```
to check the mingw and finally
```
scons platform=windows
```
you will get
```
ERROR: No valid compilers found, use MINGW_PREFIX environment variable to set MinGW path.

```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

None
